Title: Otitis media and speech and language: a meta-analysis of prospective studies.
Journal: Pediatrics
Outcome: receptive language; expressive language; vocabulary; syntax; speech development
Evidence_Quote: We conducted a meta-analysis of prospective studies to determine: 1) whether a history of OME in early childhood is related to receptive language, expressive language, vocabulary, syntax, or speech development in children 1 to 5 years old and 2) whether hearing loss caused by otitis media in early childhood is related to children's receptive language or expressive language through 2 years of age.
